answer.label: An anonymous joke, not a verified Barrie quotation
answer.sourceLine: The title compresses a joke about mistaking abstract words for captured places. QI traces the joke family to 1782; Barrie used a different version in his fiction. It is not evidence of a real military report or Barrie’s original aphorism.
